summary:
We developed TerraMatch, an interactive planetary analog discovery and telemetry platform for the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge. TerraMatch helps researchers, engineers, and mission planners identify and evaluate terrestrial environments on Earth that share key geological, topographic, thermal, or atmospheric conditions with permanent Moon-base locations and Mars landing sites.

The platform combines a global catalog of 51+ verified analog sites with a live "Probe Any Earth Coordinate" tool and Whole-Earth Scan powered by the NASA POWER Climatology API and Open-Meteo elevation data. Users can filter locations by planetary target, mission preset, terrain, aridity, temperature, and elevation, inspect 4-dimensional scientific fidelity breakdowns against NASA PDS (LRO LOLA, Diviner, MGS MOLA, Mars ODE) and partner datasets (ISRO Chandrayaan-1 M3, CSA, ESA, JAXA), and compare candidates side by side.

This is important because no single place on Earth perfectly replicates another world. By clearly showing both why an analog matches and where Earth's analogy breaks down, TerraMatch helps teams choose smarter, safer environments for rover and hardware testing before launch.
details:
TerraMatch is an interactive planetary analog discovery and live telemetry platform built to identify and characterize locations on Earth that share key geological, topographic, thermal, and atmospheric conditions with permanent Moon-base locations and future Mars landing sites.

  1. 51+ Verified Planetary Analog Catalog: Maps established and emerging Moon and Mars analog sites across hyper-arid deserts, polar impact craters, basaltic volcanic fields, subsurface lava tubes, and acidic iron-sulfate rivers.
  2. Live "Probe Any Earth Coordinate" & Whole-Earth Scan: Users can click any coordinate on Earth or run a global scan to fetch real-time satellite climatology from the NASA POWER API (T2M surface temperature, RH2M relative humidity, PRECTOTCORR precipitation, and ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN solar irradiance) and terrain elevation from Open-Meteo, evaluating any spot on Earth against lunar and Martian baselines.
  3. Mission-Driven Environmental Search Console: Filters analog sites by target body (Moon or Mars), mission preset (Artemis South Pole, VIPER Regolith Mobility, Perseverance Sample Caching, ExoMars Subsurface Drilling, Lava Tube Habitat), rover objective, geology, aridity, temperature (-60°C to 50°C), and elevation (0 m to 4,800 m).
  4. 4-Dimension Scientific Fidelity & "Where the Analogy Breaks Down": Evaluates every site across Geology & Mineralogy, Topography & Terrain, Thermal & Climate Regime, and Water/Ice & ISRU Resources—while explicitly documenting physical limits where Earth's analogy breaks down (gravity 1.62 m/s² on the Moon and 3.71 m/s² on Mars vs. 9.81 m/s² on Earth, atmospheric pressure, radiation, and regolith abrasiveness).
  5. Side-by-Side Comparison & Workspace: Let's researchers compare multiple Earth sites side by side and save candidates via Google Authentication or instant guest storage.

Benefits & Intended Impact
Before space agencies send rovers, drills, or habitats to the Moon or Mars, they must test them on Earth. However, well-known analog sites are over-utilized and no single Earth location replicates another planet completely. TerraMatch empowers mission planners, astrobiologists, and university robotics teams to discover under-utilized analog testbeds anywhere on Earth in seconds and immediately see both what matches and what must be compensated for in lab chambers.
Tools, Coding Languages & Software Used

  • Frontend: JavaScript (ES6+), React 19, Vite 8, React Router v7, Tailwind CSS v4, DaisyUI v5, Leaflet & React-Leaflet (EPSG:4326 WMS/Esri satellite imagery), Lucide React, Axios, Firebase v13 (Google OAuth).
  • Backend & Database: Node.js, Express.js v5, MongoDB Atlas (TerraMatch cloud database).
  • Deployment & Media: Vercel, GitHub, Google Flow (AI video animation with visible watermark), and ElevenLabs (AI voiceover narration, acknowledged in project metadata and video description).

Creativity & Factors Considered
Instead of treating analog matching as a single black-box percentage, we designed TerraMatch around multi-dimensional scientific transparency—combining a curated mission-history catalog with live, keyless global coordinate probing and explicit "Where the Analogy Breaks Down" engineering disclosures.
